build_llavavid_model: build a LLaVa video model instance with LlavaConfig and optional quantization config for inference
encode_images_video: encode video or image pixel values through CLIP vision tower and multi-modal projector to produce image features
pad_input_ids: pad input ids by replacing image token placeholders with image feature embeddings from multimodal inputs
run_forward_pass: run forward pass on LLaVa video model with input ids, positions, and forward batch for extend or decode mode
load_weights_model: load HuggingFace-compatible weights into LLaVa video model including vision tower, projector, and language model
